# WODI

> WODI (https://wodi.fit) is a social CrossFit app that turns your training into something worth sharing. Snap the gym's whiteboard or just chat to log a workout, and WODI makes a poster of every session, Wrapped-style recaps of every week, month and season, and a feed where you follow and cheer the people you train with.

WODI is an independent app that runs in the browser on iPhone, Android and desktop and can be added to the home screen like a native app. It is not affiliated with Wodify, wodii.ai, or other apps with similar names, and is unrelated to "WODI" as used in cricket (Women's One Day International).

## Made to show off

- **A poster for every workout**: each session becomes a designed poster with several looks and a mood stamp, ready to save or share
- **Wrapped, all year round**: Spotify Wrapped-style story recaps for every week, month and season — total reps, total weight moved, top movement, engine work, new personal bests and a training persona
- **A social feed**: follow the athletes you train with, cheer and like their workouts, post a selfie with the board
- **PR moments**: new personal records on lifts and named benchmark WODs (Fran, Murph, etc.) get their own celebration
- **Week body map**: see at a glance which parts of your body you trained this week

## Logging in seconds

- **Snap the board**: reads AMRAP, EMOM, For Time, strength sets, chippers, intervals and partner workouts from a photo
- **Just chat**: tell WODI how it went in plain words ("6 rounds plus 10, 60 kg on the cleans") and it logs the result
- **Remembers your weights**: shows what you loaded last time for each movement
- **A training buddy**: WODI knows your history and answers questions about your training

## Who it's for

People who train CrossFit or functional fitness at a box (gym) and want their training to feel as good to look back on as it felt to do — without typing workouts into a spreadsheet.
